observations: Collection: per variant 144 raw transitions (6 sessions x 24 interactions), 112 valid, 32 link-click leakages (target URL normalized == next URL), 80 non-leakage transitions; leakages form 100% of link_click records per variant.
NL action primitives per variant: form_submit=36, button_click=26, js_navigate=18; action_target is None on all 80 NL records.

State space: 4 URL states for vanillajs/react/svelte (no-fragment base, '#', '#/active', '#/completed'), 3 for vue (explicit '#' base only) and angular ('#/all', '#/active', '#/completed'); '#/active' and '#/completed' are distinct states.

Observed log Bayes factor is NEGATIVE on all 5 real variants at all 3 alphas (range -10.380 to -15.568 nats): the memory-only model M0 (url_before + H_K2) is favored over action-conditioned M1 at K=12 under the Occam penalty.

Within-session shuffled-action null is more negative still (null median -24.821 to -39.730 nats; null max -19.107 to -29.926 nats); observed exceeds every one of the 1999 null samples in all 15 (variant x alpha) cells -> p=0.0005 (permutation floor), so the observed action arrangement is statistically unlike a random shuffle even though M0 wins absolutely.

Positive control replication: observed 167.9/338.7/643.1 nats vs parent 168/338/643; null medians -78.4/-130.9/-116.1 vs parent -78/-131/-116; p=0.0005. Estimator implementation validated bit-identically vs EXP-PHYSICS-35578258358.

vanillajs, react and svelte produce bit-identical measurements; vue and angular produce bit-identical measurements. Expected under isomorphic deterministic 4-state FSMs with identical action protocols (verified by CTRL_VARIANT_ISOMORPHISM).

K2 strata: 17/18 deterministic (94.4%) for vanillajs/react/svelte, 11/13 (84.6%) for vue/angular; per-stratum decomposition (vanillajs, alpha=1.0) shows the negative observed BF is driven by two multi-record deterministic strata (-9.68 nats for the '#/' -> '#/' stratum, -2.15 for '#/completed' -> '#/completed'); the two stochastic strata contribute +0.30/+0.56 nats; all other strata contribute exactly 0.00 nats.

Baselines: B1 conditional MI 0.0581-0.0716 bits > 0 (small action signal conditional on url_before); B2 action-history K=3 accuracy 1.0 on all variants; B3 state-history K2 MI 0.7020-0.8269 bits (memory alone strongly predicts next state).

Encoding diagnostic: with action=action_target the model comparison is degenerate (log BF = 0.000000 exactly, alpha=1.0) because the action variable is constant; action_primitive is the sole non-degenerate action encoding on this dataset.
validity_notes: URL resolution deviation: the spec shorthand URLs (todomvc.com/examples/{vanillajs,react,vue,angular,svelte}/) return HTTP 404; live serving URLs are the dist paths frozen by infra parent EXP-PHYSICS-35209110569 (javascript-es6/dist, react/dist, vue/dist, angular/dist/browser, svelte/dist). Same five variants, same hash-routing behavior; documented here so AUDIT/DIRECTOR do not treat this as a spec violation.

Action-variable resolution: prereg.md states 'Action: URL of the action target (action.target_href)'. That field is only meaningful for link_click records, which are by definition filtered out as leakages conjunction on 100% of records; action_target is None for all NL records, making it a constant. Verified: action-target-as-action yields log BF = 0.000000. The model action is therefore action_primitive, matching the PMI-pipeline parent EXP-PHYSICS-35262258744 whose baseline numbers this spec cites. Frozen K=12 category space, priors and shuffles unchanged.

Detection vs absolute preference: C3 measures separation of the observed log BF from the within-session shuffled-action null. On the real variants the observed BF is negative (M0 wins absolutely at K=12); the separation is real (observed exceeds all 1999 null samples) but does NOT establish action-conditioned dynamics over memory on the absolute scale. The claim ceiling must remain 'URL-level fragment-aware state representation; action-conditioned model comparison separated from within-session shuffled-action null (5/5 variants, all alphas)'.

p-value resolution floor: with N_SHUFFLE=1999 the smallest representable p is 0.0005; C3's '<0.001' is satisfied at the floor, and any finer resolution (e.g., N_SHUFFLE=9999) is untested in this frozen run.

K=12 category-space carryover: K=12 is frozen from the parent chain and dominates the Occam penalty because observed state cardinality is only 3-4. BF magnitudes (-10.4 to -15.6) are therefore not directly comparable to the synthetic setting (K matches n_states=12 there); sensitivity to data-matched K is untested (not frozen).

Near-deterministic environment: B2=1.0 and 85-94% deterministic K2 strata confirm the TodoMVC hash-SPA environment is a near-deterministic finite state machine at fragment-aware URL resolution; the 6 scripted sessions per variant are near-identical by construction, which reduces independent measurement mass. Generalization to stateful, stochastic, or history-dependent web apps is untested.

Permutation null shuffles actions within sessions while preserving (z,a)-cell cardinality; the null distribution is heavily negative because shuffled assignments mix outcomes inside deterministic cells. This is the frozen null; its validity on this data is evidenced by C6 (synthetic replication-exact) and the C1 requirement (all null medians < 0).

Representation loss: final canonical URL after interaction can collapse distinct app states that differ only in DOM/JS state (e.g., input focus, edited content of the todo text field). The measurement is defined on fragment-aware URL states only, per the frozen design.

Collection infrastructure: requires live network (todomvc.com reachable, verified); chromium headless via Playwright 1.63.0. Intermittent Vue '#/' click timeouts were handled with force=True; timestamps recorded per interaction. A collection infrastructure failure would map to status=BLOCKED, not to a scientific negative; no such failure occurred.

Run reproducibility: all pseudo-random streams seeded (seed=42); the positive control and all 15 (variant x alpha) null distributions are bit-reproducible from raw_synthetic.json / nl_transitions_*.json via run_experiment.py.
unresolved: Whether the frozen C3 'detection' (relative-to-null separation at p<=0.0005) should be interpreted as claim-supporting evidence given that the observed log BF is negative (M0 memory-only wins on the absolute scale at K=12). The frozen decision rule yields SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST; Director must adjudicate whether the claim ceiling should be rewritten to make the relative-detection semantics explicit.

Sensitivity of the verdict to K (category count): K=12 over-penalizes the tiny observed state spaces (S=3-4); a data-matched K would change the absolute BF scale and possibly the C1/C3 reading. Untested because K=12 is frozen.

B1 baseline discrepancy: this run's URL-conditional MI is 0.0581-0.0716 bits while parent EXP-PHYSICS-35262258744 cited 0.188-0.209 bits for its URL-only PMI baseline (different computation scope/definition). Needs reconciliation if B1 is ever promoted to a gate.
Permutation p resolution floor: p=0.0005 is the minimal resolvable value at N_SHUFFLE=1999; observed exceeded ALL 1999 samples, so the true p may be much smaller. Finer resolution untested.

Measurement independence: 5/5 variant passes include two pairs of bit-identical isomorphic environments ({vanillajs,react,svelte} and {vue,angular}); the effective independent replications may be 2 rather than 5. Not resolvable within this frozen design.

Generalization to non-TodoMVC, non-deterministic, or stateful (non-URL-representable) web applications is untested; the physics claim's bounds are limited to near-deterministic fragment-routed SPAs with 3-4 observable URL states.
